hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/dist/*) ;; *) "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt" "$f" ;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
bash -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test || exit 2'
